Priority: high
athena drain stops on any item whose reader failed: it calls the run step, which errors with 'has no reading yet (the reader failed)', counts that as a failure twice and stops (2026-10-28, twice on the same item). An item in that state needs a fresh read, not a run. Fix: drain reads an item whose reader failed again (with the last refusal text given to the reader, as the single re-read after a refusal already does) before trying to run it; if that read fails too, drain records it and moves on to the next item instead of stopping the run.
Acceptance:
- A drain test with an item whose reader failed shows drain re-reads it and, when the read is accepted, runs it.
- A drain test shows an item whose re-read also fails is skipped with a reason and the drain goes on to the next item.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, CHANGELOG.md
